noauth_local_server.description: Set to false to enable remote auth (e.g., via port forwarding)

config_folder.description: Deprecated; use $GCALCLI_CONFIG instead. Path to config directory.

calendars.description: List of calendars to use globally (preferred per-command). Each object has 'name'. Optional color can be embedded in name (e.g., 'Work#blue').

default_calendar.description: Default calendar name to use if none specified

refresh.description: Set to true to delete and refresh cached data

nocache.description: Set to false to enable cache usage

conky.description: Set to true to enable Conky color codes

color.description: Set to false to disable all color output

lineart.description: Line art style for calendars: 'fancy', 'unicode', or 'ascii'
